source.description: A pale witch in a dark-blue fur-edged cloak holding a staff topped with a glowing icicle, standing calmly. Cloak and silver hair drift in the cold wind, the icicle pulsing with light. Seamless loop.

The pale witch with the icicle-topped staff attacks — she raises the staff high as the icicle flares bright, then thrusts it forward launching a shard of ice toward the camera, then lowers the staff back to her side.

_notes: v3 humanoid character, south direction only. Base sprite approved pre-session; idle+attack generated via v3, self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
